name: 75207 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75207 (Dallas) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75207 (Dallas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75207 (Dallas) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
